# Load the dataset and display the first few rows to understand its structure
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
df.head()

# Check for missing values and data types in the dataset
df.info()

# Calculate the total amount spent in each category
total_spent_by_category = df.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum().reset_index()

# Identify the category with the highest total spending
highest_spending_category = total_spent_by_category.loc[total_spent_by_category['Amount'].idxmax()]

total_spent_by_category, highest_spending_category

# Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the transaction amounts
mean_amount = df['Amount'].mean()
std_amount = df['Amount'].std()

# Define a threshold for anomalous transactions (e.g., more than 2 standard deviations above the mean)
threshold = mean_amount + 2 * std_amount

# Identify anomalous transaction amounts
anomalous_transactions = df[df['Amount'] > threshold]

mean_amount, std_amount, threshold, anomalous_transactions
